who_suffers.quote: Mary Henry, a young woman whose life is disturbed after a car accident
She relocates to a new city, where she finds herself unable to assimilate with the locals

moments.quote: you cannot live in isolation from the human race, you know.

who_suffers.quote: As though I had no place in the world, no part of the life around me.
